The
Company
Awaysis
Capital, Inc. is a real estate management and hospitality company focused on the acquisition, redevelopment, ownership, sale, and management
of residential vacation properties and resort communities in desirable travel destinations.
Our
business strategy is to identify and reposition real estate properties that management believes have the potential to generate value
through improvements, hospitality operations, residential sales, and property management services. Our operations include the development
and management of vacation accommodations, short-term and long-term rentals, and related hospitality and property management activities.
Our
current operations and development activities are concentrated in Belize, principally in San Pedro on Ambergris Caye. We also have
operations in the Cayo District of Belize, which we have recently ceased developing pending a potential unwinding of our acquisition of this property. Although the Company has previously identified opportunities in the Caribbean, Europe, South
America, and the United States, these locations represent potential longer-term strategic interests rather than current development
commitments.
As
of the filing date of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the Company has no additional properties under contract or option and has not
committed to new acquisition targets since September 2025. While we consider properties, assets and companies consistent with our business
plan for acquisition or management from time to time, including entering into non-binding letters of intent, we have not entered into
nor are we negotiating any definitive agreements for such properties, assets or companies at this time.
Business
Strategy and Operating Priorities
The
Company’s current operating strategy emphasizes the completion and commercialization of its existing Casamora property, the generation
of recurring hospitality, booking and rental revenues, the management of construction expenditures, and the preservation of available
capital.
Given
the Company’s current financial obligations and the capital requirements associated with its existing developments, management
is prioritizing activities expected to produce near-term operating cash flows while evaluating opportunities to reduce indebtedness and
improve the Company’s financial position.
The
Company intends to continue developing its property management and hospitality operations through a combination of Company-owned accommodations
and units owned by third parties who elect to participate in Company-managed booking programs.
Under
these arrangements, property owners may retain their units for personal use or enter into management agreements with the Company for
short-term or long-term bookings, subject to applicable laws and contractual restrictions. Management fees and the allocation of bookings
proceeds are governed by the respective agreements.
The
Company’s ability to execute its development strategy depends on several factors, including access to additional financing, operating
cash flows, construction costs, market demand, and the availability of qualified contractors and service providers.
Properties
Awaysis
Casamora
On
June 30, 2022, the Company completed the acquisition of certain real estate assets in San Pedro, Belize (the “Awaysis Casamora
Assets”), pursuant to purchase and sale agreements dated April 15, 2022.
The
aggregate consideration was approximately $11.4 million, excluding transaction costs and fees, consisting of purchase money mortgages
totaling approximately $2.88 million and 56.8 million shares of the Company’s common stock valued at $0.15 per share. The $280,000
purchase money mortgage was repaid on August 8, 2022.
The
remaining $2.6 million purchase money mortgage bears no stated interest and is payable on demand, subject to its contractual terms and
any subsequent amendments. The Company subsequently rebranded the acquired assets as Awaysis Casamora.
The
Awaysis Casamora Assets, which remain under construction, are located in San Pedro, Belize, minutes away from the town core, and is a 2.5 acres site with 300 feet of beach
frontage overlooking the reef that is less than a mile offshore. The property is expected to feature 30 renovated 1-, 2- & 3- bedroom
private suites, a wellness spa and fitness facility, gourmet dining restaurant, executive remote work center, private roof top lounge,
and lap pool. Along the water edge, there is planned a beach bar and waterfront esplanade.
There
are 4 distinct components to the property:
●
Oceanfront
Condominium Complex . The principal four-story condominium complex contains 20 individually
stratified two-bedroom, two-bathroom condominium units, with average interior space of approximately
1,400 square feet and additional balcony areas of approximately 250 square feet.
Twelve
units are identified as available for resale. Construction and renovation activities are ongoing, with certain units requiring additional
interior finishing and related improvements before they can be offered as completed accommodations.
The
Company previously estimated remaining construction expenditures for this component at approximately $2.5 million. Actual expenditures
and completion schedules will depend on updated contractor estimates, construction progress, and available financing.
●
Amenities
and Commercial Building . The approximately 10,000-square-foot amenities building adjacent to the condominium complex has been
renovated and is intended to support commercial and hospitality activities.The building has been leased to a third-party tenant under
an arrangement initially providing monthly rental payments of $13,000 USD until June 30, 2027, with an option for an additional two
years. The same tenant is leasing the three story mixed use building under the same periods for a monthly payment of $5,500.00 USD.
●
Waterfront
Villas . The property includes two two-story waterfront villas. The north villa contains
four one-bedroom, one-bathroom units. The south villa contains two one-bedroom, one-bathroom
ground-floor units and a three-bedroom, three-bathroom upper-level unit.
The Company has undertaken renovations
and refurbishment activities involving these villas, including roofing, balconies, interior improvements, and related construction work.
Management is prioritizing the completion and availability of selected units for rental operations, subject to available working capital
and construction requirements.
●
Three-Story
Mixed-Use Building . The property also includes a three-story mixed-use building with
residential and commercial space. The building contains ground-floor office space, second-floor
space suitable for residential or other permitted use, and a furnished three-bedroom penthouse.
The Company has previously entered into
rental arrangements covering the penthouse and additional space within the building. These arrangements provide recurring rental income
and support the Company’s strategy of generating revenue from completed portions of the development.
All
villas, suites and units may be occupied by the owner or they may contract with us to manage short or long term bookings of the units
for a fee, making it a flexible option for those that either wish to occupy part-time, or that wish to rent their unit without management
responsibility.
Development
Strategy
Management’s
immediate priority is to increase the number of accommodations available for rental and improve the revenue-generating capacity of the
existing development.
The
Company’s development plan includes completing selected waterfront villa renovations, improving common areas and guest access,
and continuing construction activities within the condominium complex as financing permits.
As
of the filing date, the Company has identified six units as available for sale or short-term or long-term booking, including four Company-owned
units and two units managed on behalf of third-party owners. These are expected to be available for rental for the upcoming peak season.
Management
previously estimated total remaining development costs of approximately $3.015 million, comprising approximately $2.5 million for the
condominium complex and $515,000 for the waterfront villas. These amounts represent prior development estimates and are subject to revision
based on updated construction budgets, engineering assessments, contractor pricing, and the scope of work ultimately approved.
The
Company is targeting completion of additional development activities during calendar year 2027. However, there can be no assurance that
the Company will complete the improvements within the anticipated period.
The
Company’s actual rental rates, occupancy, and revenue performance will depend on the condition and availability of completed units,
tourism demand, competition, seasonality, and prevailing market conditions.
